program.name: Bell Ladders
program.subject: Kettlebell complexes
program.blurb: Kettlebell ladders: one rep of each move, then two, then three, climbing until the clock stops.
program.about: Kettlebell ladders that climb. A short chain of moves, a clean, a press and a front squat, is done once, then twice, then three times, and on up the ladder until the clock stops. Each day ends with a few minutes of loaded core work. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
